summary: Comprehensive testing of premium WhatsApp/review UI changes across Table Booking, Catering, and Tiffin pages. All features working correctly - premium review cards display with dark headers, amber gold accents, card-based layouts, tagline, and 'Powered by A.AI Technology' footer.
